items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Stockyard Blues, that's mine. I just simply had my, played over on the Zillophone and Freddie, got the boys together.

ctx.x: Yeah. Uh, while we're thinking of Keppard, I did want to ask a good deal about that, about him, because you made the only record that his name was ever on the label, Freddie Keppard, the Stockyard and the Salty Dog. Yes. You were on that date. And then the other record was made about the same time, the one under your name.
Yeah, well, Stockyard Blues, that's mine. I just simply had my, played over on the Zillophone and Freddie, got the boys together. And, you know, it didn't take very long before they fall in. Yes.
Can you remember who else was on the date?
